messages.text: Hi Chris, the 2 P.M. meeting with the design team is now at 3. Their flight was delayed.
Room B is taken at 3, so we'll use the small room upstairs.
OK. I'll bring the extra chairs from my office.

options: A. Room B was being cleaned.
C. Chris has another meeting at 2.
D. Some attendees are arriving late.
questions.explanation: Nadia says the time changed because "Their flight was delayed."

questions.stem: Why will Chris most likely bring extra chairs?
options: A. The new room may not have enough seats.
B. Room B has broken furniture.
C. His office will be used for the meeting.
D. The design team asked for them.
questions.explanation: The meeting moved to "the small room upstairs," so it probably lacks enough chairs.
